Harbour Street bread

We bake rye, sourdough and seeded loaves through the night, and the shop opens when the first trays cool.

Find the shop

Three loaves, one oven

The oven is the brick oven the bakery opened with in 1962. It holds sixty loaves, so each morning brings three kinds and no more.

Rye on Monday, sourdough every day, seeded bread on the weekend.

Visit

Monday to Friday, 7 in the morning until the bread runs out. Saturday and Sunday, 8 until noon.

14 Harbour Street, next to the ferry steps.

Harbour Street Bakery. Call 555 0142 or write to hello@example.com.
